Step 7 (no interface by sample) and step 8 (acceptance on a running system) are NOT APPLICABLE for this run: the kit has no end user and no running product; confirm or refute that in your verdict in one sentence each. (6) Check statuses and documents have not fallen behind: REQ-104 is in_progress (DOC-UPDATER sets done after your PASS); list for DOC-UPDATER anything stale (design counts 50 kit tests, 63 total, 10 fixtures; REQ-038 and REQ-040 wording 'check ends with npm run test'; the raw SAI_CHROME path in START_FAILED as a new Low defect; root README time claim). Report to me in at most 12 lines.

issues.text: The task said outcome A means '.github unchanged' and that the snapshot is built from the current working tree. Both hold. One correction of the method for the next run of this kind: a snapshot must not contain the validator's own handoff with status PENDING or IN_PROGRESS (handoffs-check H4 goes red on GitHub); I rebuilt it without that one file. This is the same as the precedent, where the own handoff was excluded.

Time on GitHub: the whole job is 836 s (13 min 56 s) against the 1500 s watch value of decisions/0106 and the 1800 s limit; the e2e step took 25.5 s there. The next requirements REQ-105..107 add to the e2e part; the watch value stays the owner's trigger.

Lesson for docs/anti-patterns.md (DOC-UPDATER decides): the snapshot commit for a check on a temporary branch must exclude the validator's own handoff while it is not finished, or the first run on GitHub fails at handoffs-check (H4); it cost one extra run of 53 s here.
